additions.group: 極小計算・プログラム生成・検証可能推論
additions.reason_selected: A from-scratch 94.7M code-generating math word problem solver, strong for its extremely small size by symbolic execution: publisher greedy GSM8K test 1319 accuracy 54.7%. System can pair with 94.7M checker and use 48 attempts to reach 72.3%, but paired result is NOT single-model quality.
additions.risk_and_alternative_assessment: Not a chatbot; fails unanswerable tasks, irrelevant-number and unit-conversion cases. 48-attempt score is expensive program-execution ensemble and cannot be compared to a single inference. Model-generated Python must never be automatically executed during download or validation.
